mentions.name: The Dwell
mentions.description: This site provides data on ship and truck dwell times and port congestion. It was launched as one of the nine site ideas ChatGPT suggested for this type of site and is performing best so far from a traffic perspective.
mentions.source_excerpt: I decided to launch the next 9 of the top 10 ideas that ChatGPT came up with for this type of site - won't post all of them here, but https://the-dwell.com/ (data on ship and truck dwell times/port congestion) is doing the best thus far from a traffic perspective.

mentions.name: The Dwell
mentions.description: A website that pulls public data from government PDFs and APIs, uses LLMs to parse it, and turns it into an easily readable site presenting the latest container ship dwell times, with weekly email updates sent via Buttondown.
mentions.source_excerpt: The Dwell (https://the-dwell.com/) for container ship dwell times.
